title: Best ITSM Tools with Microsoft Teams Integration in 2026
summary: Explore 12 ITSM tools with Microsoft Teams integration in 2026, comparing AI, automation, ticketing, workflows, and service management.
body_markdown:
Microsoft Teams has become a central workspace for more than[330,000 companies worldwide](https://pulse.microsoft.com/en/work-productivity-en/na/fa2-reasons-why-you-should-start-using-microsoft-teams-today/?ref=unthread.io) . Forcing employees to leave Teams to submit IT requests can add unnecessary context switching to internal support. The best[ITSM tools](https://unthread.io/solutions/it-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) in 2026 connect service management with Teams so IT, HR, finance, procurement, and operations teams can capture requests, automate workflows, and coordinate resolutions closer to where employees already work.


This guide evaluates 12 platforms based on Teams integration depth, AI capabilities, workflow automation, internal service management functionality, and deployment requirements. Whether an organization needs conversational ticketing or a broader enterprise service management platform, these tools offer different approaches to[Microsoft Teams support](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) .


## **Key Takeaways**


- Teams-integrated ITSM tools can let employees create requests, receive updates, and interact with internal support without continually switching applications.
- Unthread combines Microsoft Teams and Slack intake with a unified internal support workflow for IT, HR, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace teams.
- AI capabilities vary from knowledge-based answers and ticket routing to autonomous workflows and Tier 1 request resolution.
- Teams integration depth differs significantly. Some platforms support conversational ticketing and ticket actions in Teams, while others rely more heavily on their web portals.
- Organizations should evaluate workflow flexibility, privacy controls, AI coverage, administration requirements, and cross-channel support alongside core ticketing features.


## **1) Unthread: Best AI-Native Internal Help Desk for Teams and Slack**

It supports Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, and web-based intake while giving internal service teams a unified place to manage tickets, routing, assignments, SLAs, approvals, and automations.


**Best for:** Organizations using Microsoft Teams, Slack, or both that want conversational internal support without making employees depend on a separate service portal.


**Price:** Starts at $50 per agent per month when billed annually, with a five-seat minimum.


**G2 Rating:**[4.9/5](https://www.g2.com/products/unthread/reviews?ref=unthread.io)


### **Key Features**


- Turn conversations into structured tickets with assignments, priorities, SLAs, and escalation paths.
- Use a purpose-built AI agent that can[automatically resolve 40%](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) of incoming requests in documented customer deployments.
- Manage Tier 1 workflows across IT, HR, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations.
- Build[workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) using natural language, a visual builder, or custom logic.
- Create and maintain a[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) from recurring support conversations.
- Connect internal workflows with Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other business systems.
- Support bring-your-own-LLM requirements through MCP.


### **Microsoft Teams Experience**


Employees can ask for help through Teams while Unthread turns those conversations into trackable internal requests. Routine questions can stay conversational, while workflows that require assignments, approvals, or escalation can run behind the scenes.


Sensitive requests can also move into private workflows. That is particularly useful for HR issues involving benefits, payroll, employee documentation, leave, or policy questions.


### **Why It Made the List**


Unthread is designed for organizations that want conversational intake without giving up structured service management. It also supports both Teams and Slack, which can be useful for organizations operating across multiple collaboration environments.


For internal teams evaluating how conversational service management would work in practice,[book a demo](https://unthread.io/demo?ref=unthread.io) .


## **2) Freshservice**


Freshservice provides ITSM, IT operations management, IT asset management, and enterprise service management capabilities within a cloud-based platform. Its Microsoft Teams functionality centers on ServiceBot, which lets employees interact with service workflows and access support without beginning every request in the Freshservice portal.


### **Key Features**


- Freddy AI Agent for conversational self-service
- Ticket creation and status interactions through Teams
- Approvals from Teams notifications
- ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and service request management
- CMDB and asset management capabilities
- Search across connected knowledge sources


### **Microsoft Teams Experience**


ServiceBot supports ticket creation, updates, approvals, and conversational interactions from Microsoft Teams. More detailed service management and administrative work remains available through the Freshservice interface.


### **Considerations**


Freshservice is designed as a broader ITSM platform rather than a Teams-only help desk. Organizations should evaluate how much of their employee and agent workflow needs to remain directly inside Teams versus the main Freshservice environment.


### **Why It Made the List**


Freshservice combines Teams-based employee interactions with established ITSM, asset management, and service management capabilities.


## **3) Desk365**


Desk365 focuses heavily on Microsoft Teams-based ticketing. Its Support Bot serves employees submitting requests, while agent-facing capabilities help internal support teams work with tickets and service processes in a Microsoft-centric environment.


### **Key Features**


- Support Bot for employee requests
- Agent-facing ticket management
- Microsoft Entra ID SSO
- Intune synchronization
- Automated routing
- SLA management
- Teams-based ticket interactions


### **Microsoft Teams Experience**


Desk365 is designed to keep a large portion of the ticket lifecycle inside Microsoft Teams. Employees can submit and follow requests from Teams, while agents can access service desk functionality through Teams-based experiences.


### **Considerations**


Its Teams-first approach can fit organizations standardized around Microsoft's collaboration stack. Teams using several employee communication channels may need to compare its cross-channel workflow capabilities with broader internal service platforms.


### **Why It Made the List**


Desk365 provides a focused approach to conversational ticketing for organizations that want Microsoft Teams to remain the primary interface for employee support.


## **4) Jira Service Management**


Jira Service Management combines service management with Atlassian's broader ecosystem of development, collaboration, and knowledge management tools. Its Teams capabilities are particularly relevant for organizations already using Jira and Confluence.


### **Key Features**


- Incident and service request management
- Virtual agent capabilities
- Connections with Jira Software
- Confluence knowledge management
- Change management workflows
- On-call and incident response functionality


### **Microsoft Teams Experience**


Teams can serve as a collaboration layer for notifications and selected service management interactions. More detailed service configuration, queue management, and agent workflows typically remain within Jira Service Management.


### **Considerations**


The platform can be particularly relevant when internal IT workflows need to connect closely with engineering work. Organizations focused primarily on employee-facing conversational support should compare how much of the request lifecycle remains inside Teams.


### **Why It Made the List**


Jira Service Management connects IT service workflows with software development and knowledge management, making it relevant for organizations already operating within the Atlassian ecosystem.


## **5) InvGate Service Management**

- Virtual service agent

- Incident and request management
- Service catalog
- Asset and service management capabilities

Its virtual service agent brings conversational employee interactions into Teams. Knowledge content can be surfaced before a request is escalated to an internal support agent.


### **Considerations**


Organizations should assess which administrative and agent activities can be handled inside Teams and which require the main InvGate interface.


### **Why It Made the List**


InvGate combines Teams-based conversational assistance with broader IT service management functionality for internal IT organizations.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What are the primary benefits of integrating ITSM tools with Microsoft Teams?**


Teams integration lets employees submit requests, receive updates, answer follow-up questions, and interact with internal service teams from the collaboration environment they already use. Depending on the platform, IT teams can also perform ticket actions, approvals, routing, and other workflow steps without repeatedly moving between applications.


### **How does AI enhance ITSM workflows within Microsoft Teams?**


AI can categorize and route requests, search knowledge bases, draft answers, trigger workflows, and resolve common employee questions. Unthread's purpose-built AI agent has[automatically resolved 40%](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) of incoming tickets in a documented customer deployment across internal teams.


### **Can existing ITSM solutions be integrated with Microsoft Teams?**


Yes. Many established ITSM platforms connect with Microsoft Teams, but the depth of integration varies. Some primarily provide notifications and selected actions, while conversational platforms allow employees to complete more of the request lifecycle directly within Teams.


### **What security considerations matter when choosing a Teams-integrated ITSM tool?**


Organizations should evaluate SSO, access controls, data handling, audit capabilities, private request workflows, identity management, and relevant compliance requirements. Internal service teams handling HR, finance, or legal requests should also confirm that sensitive conversations can be separated from public or shared Teams channels.


### **How do Microsoft Teams integrations help with incident management?**


Teams integrations can bring incident communication, notifications, collaboration, and service management workflows closer together. Depending on the platform, teams can notify responders, coordinate work in dedicated channels, update tickets, and keep relevant employees informed while the underlying incident remains tracked in the ITSM system.
